🐉 Welcome to Be a Dragon Ball!

⚡Enter the Collection Zone and become a Dragon Ball!
🏃Race away from the guards before they catch you!
💨Escape back to your base with your new fighter!
📈Place characters on slots & upgrade them to earn more cash!

🌍Explore further zones for rarer characters & mutations!
🔮Roll Random Mutations!

💤 Your characters earn cash even while you're offline!
👑 +Plus players receive +1.5x Cash Boost!

UPD [V2] 🛠️:
- 2 NEW MUTATIONS
- 2 NEW ZONES
- 15+ NEW CHARACTERS
- BUG FIXES + MORE 

Like and favorite the game & join the group for rewards! 💫
